title: App silently ignores --stats-out with a missing path token instead of erroring
detail: `app --stats-out` (flag last, no token) fails the `i+1 < len(os.args)` guard, leaves stats_path empty, and runs with the stream silently off. Spec's I/O matrix requires a usage error; harness main.odin does `usage()`, the app does not.
recommended_fix: In the parse loop, when `os.args[i] == "--stats-out"` and the path token is absent, eprintln a usage error and os.exit(2), mirroring harness/main.odin's handling.

title: App stats-stream write failure prints but exits 0, not exit 1
detail: On an unwritable path (e.g. missing directory) the defer only eprintlns; main returns normally so the process exit code stays 0. The spec's error contract for the app flag is "eprintln + exit 1".
recommended_fix: Track write failure in a flag, then os.exit(1) after the defers complete (or set the exit code before returning from main).

title: overlay-check exits 0 with an overlay-free PNG when zero sim ticks stepped
detail: With cap_ms ≤ 0 (parse_ms accepts negatives; max() clamps to 0) or a pause schedule covering all of 1..wall_max, the loop never steps, stats_valid stays false, the overlay is skipped, yet a PNG is exported and the verb returns success 0 — the AC3 verification artifact silently lacks the overlay.
recommended_fix: After the loop, if !stats_valid, eprintln "no stepped tick at <ms>ms — overlay not rendered" and return 1 instead of writing an overlay-free PNG.

title: D rows never aggregate per (pipe,class,reason) — count column is always 1
detail: drop_sites carries one entry per dropped packet, so a tick shedding N same-class packets on a bundle emits N duplicate D rows per live member pipe; no code path ever produces count > 1, unlike the documented per-key aggregation.
recommended_fix: Aggregate D rows by (pipe, class, reason) in stats_compute (accumulate count per key), or state in the header that rows are per-site with count=1.
